$comment: Time-limited, evidence-based PRODUCTION dependency exceptions for the SafeBet IQ production monorepo (frontend/). Consumed by scripts/ci/security-gate.mjs (SBIQ_AUDIT_DIR=frontend). A CRITICAL is NEVER excepted here. Only HIGH advisories with NO available non-major fix may be listed, each with exploitability analysis, compensating control, owner and upgrade plan. AUD-P1-008. NOTE: production frontend currently has UN-REMEDIATED criticals (html2pdf.js/jspdf XSS+LFI needing html2pdf.js@0.14.0 major; next cache-poisoning needing 13.5.11) and clean-fixable highs (nanoid, ws, brace-expansion, fast-uri, fast-xml-builder, postcss) — these are intentionally NOT excepted so the gate blocks until they are remediated in a separate QA'd milestone.

policy.notes: Gate fails on any production Critical (no exceptions) and any production High not covered by a non-expired exception below.

exceptions.fixAvailable: major (Next 14.1.1+/14.2 LTS) for the SSRF advisory; the cache-poisoning CRITICAL is fixed by the non-major 13.5.11 patch and is NOT excepted
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — SSRF advisory is in Server Actions; verify production frontend does not enable experimental serverActions / 'use server'. Production served behind CloudFront.
exceptions.compensatingControl: CloudFront/WAF fronting; route handlers validate auth server-side.
exceptions.approvedBy: Meeshan Naidoo (required for the Next major upgrade)
exceptions.upgradePlan: Isolated Next 14.2 LTS upgrade milestone with full regression. The 13.5.11 patch (fixes the cache-poisoning critical) must land first and is not covered by this exception.

advisories: transitive rollup Arbitrary File Write; @sentry/node & @sentry/opentelemetry advisories
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — the rollup advisory is a build-time file-write; Sentry is observability tooling, not an attacker-controlled runtime input path.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Build runs in trusted CI; no untrusted rollup input.
exceptions.upgradePlan: Upgrade @sentry/nextjs to 10.x in a dedicated milestone with Sentry integration regression (source maps, tunnel route, config).

advisories: GHSA (Arbitrary File Write via Path Traversal)
exceptions.exploitability: LOW — build-time only; no untrusted bundle input in CI.
exceptions.compensatingControl: Trusted CI build; first-party sources only.
